basic_details.short_information: One post of Guest-TGT in the subject Islamiat is open at Jamia Middle School, Jamia Millia Islamia (A Central University by an Act of Parliament), New Delhi. The engagement is against a leave vacancy (maternity leave) till 25 April 2027. Applications in the prescribed form must reach the Office of the Headmistress, Jamia Middle School, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025 on or before 7 December 2026 up to 2:30 pm. Applications through e-mail will not be entertained.

Jamia Middle School, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made on the prescribed format, the "Bio-Data Form for Guest Teacher Appointment" printed on page 2 of the notice. It must reach the following address on or before 7 December 2026 up to 2:30 pm: Office of the Headmistress, Jamia Middle School, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025 The notice does not mention a postal mode or any wording for the envelope. Applications sent through e-mail will not be entertained. The bio-data form asks for the name of the candidate, father's/husband's name, date of birth, Aadhaar Card number, address, contact number and e-mail ID, category (SC, ST, OBC, PWD or GEN.), educational qualifications (exam passed, board/university, year of passing, subjects offered and % marks obtained) and professional experience, if any (institution, post held, period from and to, and subject and class taught).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet either of the two sets below. Option 1 (i): B.A. (Hons.) Islamic Studies or M.A. in Islamic Studies from a recognized University with 50% marks. Option 1 (ii): B.Ed. from a recognized university with Islamic Studies as a teaching subject. OR Option 2 (i): Alim or Fazil of any Madarsa recognized by Jamia Millia Islamia and Bachelor's degree from a recognized University with Islamic Studies as an optional subject at B.A. level with at least 50% marks in aggregate. Option 2 (ii): B.Ed. from a recognized university with Islamic Studies as a teaching subject. Knowledge of Arabic, English and Urdu. Ability to understand and interpret texts of Quran and Hadith. The age limit is not specified in the notice. The salary/payment criteria is "Pay per period basis"; the notice does not print an amount per period. The engagement is against a leave vacancy (maternity leave) till 25 April 2027. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form (Bio-Data Form for Guest Teacher Appointment) duly filled in all respects. Recent passport size photograph. Self-attested copies of mark-sheets. Self-attested copies of degrees/diploma. Self-attested copies of other testimonials.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The date and time of the interview will be notified on the JMI website and through SMS or telephonic information on the contact number provided by the applicant, to shortlisted candidates only. Candidates should therefore write a correct contact number on the bio-data form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Guest-TGT (Islamiat) at Jamia Middle School, Jamia Millia Islamia.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Headmistress, Jamia Middle School, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025 on or before 7 December 2026 up to 2:30 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.A. (Hons.) Islamic Studies or M.A. in Islamic Studies with 50% marks plus B.Ed. with Islamic Studies as a teaching subject, OR Alim or Fazil of a Madarsa recognized by JMI and a Bachelor's degree with Islamic Studies as an optional subject at B.A. level with at least 50% marks in aggregate, plus B.Ed. with Islamic Studies as a teaching subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat?
faq.answer: The salary/payment criteria is "Pay per period basis".

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat?
faq.answer: Fill in the Bio-Data Form for Guest Teacher Appointment, attach a recent passport size photograph and self-attested copies of mark-sheets, degrees/diploma and other testimonials, and make sure it reaches the Headmistress's office at Jamia Middle School by 7 December 2026, 2:30 pm.

faq.question: Q6. Can I send the JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat application by e-mail?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that applications through e-mail will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed; the date and time will be notified on the JMI website or through SMS/telephone to shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q8. Is the JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is as a Guest teacher against a leave vacancy (maternity leave) till 25 April 2027.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable skills for JMI Guest-TGT Islamiat?
faq.answer: Knowledge of Arabic, English and Urdu, and the ability to understand and interpret texts of Quran and Hadith are desirable.
